FIELD WORKBENCH BUNDLED WINDOWS VIDEO ENCODER
=============================================

Purpose
-------
This is the small, static FFmpeg executable bundled only with the Windows build
of Field Workbench for one task: numbered PNG frames -> H.264/yuv420p MP4.
Linux builds continue to use the system ffmpeg executable and do not bundle this
Windows binary.

Bundled executable
------------------
FFmpeg: n8.1.2
Compiler: GCC 16.2.0 (Rev3, MSYS2 project)
Embedded x264: core 165 r3222 b35605a
Embedded zlib: 1.3.2
ffmpeg.exe SHA-256:
  9e6f299118efd596309c5e1bcd5f4cb9410f825e1efd4ee36dc4279390ae7f47
ffmpeg.exe size: 4,056,576 bytes

FFmpeg configure command
------------------------
./configure \
  --prefix="$HOME/fwb-ffmpeg/dist" \
  --disable-everything \
  --disable-autodetect \
  --disable-debug \
  --disable-doc \
  --disable-network \
  --disable-ffplay \
  --disable-ffprobe \
  --enable-small \
  --enable-gpl \
  --enable-version3 \
  --enable-libx264 \
  --enable-zlib \
  --pkg-config-flags="--static" \
  --extra-ldflags="-static" \
  --enable-protocol=file \
  --enable-demuxer=image2 \
  --enable-decoder=png \
  --enable-encoder=libx264 \
  --enable-muxer=mp4 \
  --enable-filter=scale \
  --enable-filter=format \
  --enable-swscale

Source and license information
------------------------------
FFmpeg source used for this build:
  project: https://ffmpeg.org/
  repository: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg
  exact tag: n8.1.2
  source archive: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/archive/refs/tags/n8.1.2.tar.gz

This FFmpeg build was configured with --enable-gpl and --enable-version3 and
linked statically with libx264. See GPL-3.0.txt and FFmpeg's LICENSE.md at the
n8.1.2 tag for the applicable FFmpeg licensing terms.

x264 source linked into the executable:
  project: https://www.videolan.org/developers/x264.html
  repository: https://code.videolan.org/videolan/x264
  revision reported by the binary: r3222 b35605a
  MSYS2 package used by the build: mingw-w64-x86_64-libx264
  package/source metadata: https://packages.msys2.org/packages/mingw-w64-x86_64-libx264

x264 is GNU GPL software. See GPL-2.0.txt and the x264 COPYING file in the
corresponding upstream source revision.

zlib source linked into the executable:
  project/source: https://zlib.net/
  version reported by the binary: 1.3.2
  license: zlib License; see ZLIB_LICENSE.txt

No Field Workbench-specific patches were applied to FFmpeg, x264, or zlib for
this binary. Field Workbench invokes ffmpeg.exe as a separate process.

Redistributors
--------------
Keep this directory's license/build information with binary distributions that
include the bundled ffmpeg.exe. GPL redistribution also requires making the
corresponding source code available under the applicable license terms. The
source references and exact build configuration above identify the unmodified
upstream sources used to reproduce this executable.
